name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
objectiveText: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave. MacGrann's Dried Meats  ( 1 )

comments.body:
You don't have to fight Old Icebeard to complete this quest so you can easily solo it as soon as you can pick it up.

Old Icebeard periodicly patrols the area, just wait for him to leave the cave and you can run in, loot the chest, and run out before he even notices you.
replies: MacGrann is standing in front of a cave. This is NOT the cave with the quest item. Run back down the hill you came up to get to MacGrann (decent directions below) and you'll be facing the cave with the quest item. The elite boss does pat out of the cave and you can easily dash in and grab the item without picking up aggro.

comments.body:
To get to MacGrann: South of ICEFLOW LAKE, there are two parallel ridges (the lower has a cave named "Grizzled Den"). go between the ridges and there should be a way to get up to MacGrann (he's on the ridge facing iceflow lake,  coord: 34, 52).  

To Get his meat: Just behind MacGrann is another cave (GRIZZLED DEN - coord: 37,54). If you time it right, you can run in the cave and open and get the meat. run like hell and if u die, you can always rez and run again.

I was a lvl 12 mage when i did this quest, no issues.
happy hunting!
replies: I know this was from 2007 but THANK YOU. Couldn't figure out for the life of me how to get up there to him for turn-in.

Go east of the south tip of iceflow lake, to 39.5, 47.7 (Just south of Shimmer Ridge). Then go south-east in a valley. A wooden platform on the right side, at 36.34, 52.56 is the start of the path west and up to Tundra MacGrann. The cave is east of that platform.
Old Iceburg is alive and well thanks. I killed him twice

After you handed the meat over to MacGrann and received the Wooly Mittens from him aka completed the quest, have a look down (cave entrance at your back), there you'll find a small chest. You'll have to slide down a bit. Don't jump, you'll most likely jump over it and possibly die.
if there was a chest it was just a random spawn

comments.body: The chest is in the cave guarded by Old Icebeard at 38,54. He's a level 11 elite with about 650 HP.

Directly outside of the cave Icebeard is in, there are 2 bloody corpse piles.  If you look up from there, you should see a wooden platform with a flag.  Go to the right of the flag and up and you'll go between 2 hills and to the cave the guy is standing in.

Coordinates of the start of the path are 36,52

If you play on Dragonblight and need help finding the place, send a whisper to Celak.  I'm on fairly often and I'll lead you to the place.

36.18 52.58 is the exact spot I found for the trail up to McGrann. ....and as someone else said....you don't have to kill the elite. If you have patience just sit out of aggro, he eventually will path out of the cave, remember classic takes a stupid amount of time to loot so figure that in but yeah just grab the quest item and GTFO...you'll never need to fight.

Tundra cannot be reached from the lake side.

You have to scale the SouthEast side of the ridge (see the link for Tundra) in order to get to him.

Ice Beard is found in or walking around (be careful) the cave that is also in that area.

If you are lucky and he is outside of the cave, you may not even need to fight him.

replies:
I found the questgiver at 35,52.  You can get to him through Coldridge Valley, but it's quite a climb and he was difficult to find.

For those who lack coordinates:
If you stand directly in front of Icebeard's cave and look straight across the valley, you will see a banner and a platform on the side of the hill.  Climb up there; Tundra is further up the hill, kind of around back in a cave.

The folks who have been specific here are very helpful.  Don't post 'where is he/she?' if you have not read the above.

Tundra is actually quite easy to find.

Edit: the advice about waiting till he goes on his walk may not work.  I had killed him once before reading here re the quest.  But when I saw him going away from the cave, I darted into his cave and opened the box.

Woohoo! right?  Well, he came running back to attack me.  Yeah I killed him (lvl 12 warrior) but wasn't expecting opening the meat locker to trigger his quick return. :)

comments.body: Tundra is located at 34,51. To get there go to the platform opposite Icebeard's cave. Its at 37,53. You will have to get to the saddle over the mountains at 36,52 to reach Tundra.

Anyone of any level should be able solo this easily as Icebeard leaves his cave and wanders off to the north in regular intervals. Just keep in mind that he will come running back as soon as you open the box. So wait until he is far enough away, grab the stuff and run out of the cave and to the south presto.

Having said that, I also didn't have much trouble killing him with my level 11 Warrior. Just make sure you're at full rage (kill some boars), have a Minor Healing Potion on you and use all your abilities to their full extent. I guess gear is also a factor. Mine was average.
